lines: d23: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Nicole Russell is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d23: 🕯️ Nicole Russell is dead — the night. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d23: What Nicole kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d23: "Nicole's gone." Ruby looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Nicole." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d23: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Chloe blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.

d23: 📖 LEARNED: Diplomatic Incident (Level 1). Trust builds 2x faster. You're TOO good though — once per week you can start a diplomatic incident: villagers argue, you pick the winner (+trust with them, -trust with the loser).
d23: 📖 LEARNED: Mediation (Level 1). Let each side talk without interruption. Repeat back what you heard. People de-escalate when heard.
d23: 📖 LEARNED: Reading Tracks (Level 1). Fresh tracks have sharp edges. Old tracks crumble. You can tell how recently something passed.
d23: 📖 LEARNED: Animal Behavior (Level 1). Most animals flee. Give them an escape route and they take it. Cornered animals fight.
d23: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d23: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Nicole Russell, 23 days. The mantle passes to Chloe Dubois.
d23: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Chloe Dubois, 30 — an interpreter. Her hands know different work now: Green Whisper.
d23: The village's quarrel was with Nicole — and Nicole is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d23: At the grave, Reagan, Helga, Ines and 1 more speak for Chloe — "Nicole trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d23: The fire knew Chloe before the Codex did — her name already carried weight here.
